briefdescription.para: Vendored Holoborodko mpfr::mpreal C++ wrapper over MPFR.

detaileddescription.para: Single-header library (GPL/LGPL) bundled in-tree because most Linux distributions do not package it. Provides mpfr::mpreal, an mpfr_t-backed arbitrary-precision real type with full C++ operator overloads, the standard transcendental functions (sin, cos, exp, log, ...), IEEE-754 specials (nan(), inf()), and stream I/O. Most M2 engine code calls MPFR's C API directly through ARingRRR; this header is consulted in the few places where operator overloads make code dramatically more readable, including boost::multiprecision::mpfr_float-backed paths.

The upstream license block above must be preserved verbatim when updating from a newer release. Track the project at http://www.holoborodko.com/pavel/mpfr; bump only when there is an MPFR API change the engine needs.
